name: Jungle
notes: Dense, tangled seasonally-moist (monsoon) forest and rainforest edge: shorter canopy than true rainforest, thick bamboo and giant-herb understory, vines. Drawn on Indo-Burma monsoon forest, SE Asian secondary jungle, Amazon bamboo forest and Congo-margin secondary growth.

associations.name: Teak-bamboo moist deciduous forest

associations.name: Sal forest
associations.where: gently sloping foothill terraces and plains of the Indo-Gangetic belt, deep loam
associations.source: Champion & Seth 1968 (moist sal forest); Puri 1960 Indian Forest Ecology

associations.name: Amazon guadua bamboo forest
associations.where: poorly drained lowland and valley floor of SW Amazonia with a shorter open canopy
associations.source: Griscom & Ashton 2003 Bamboo control of forest succession (Forest Ecology and Management); Nelson 1994

associations.name: Cecropia secondary growth
associations.where: abandoned clearings, landslides and river banks in full sun, a few years after disturbance
